purpose: Evaluate five established horizontal baselines across SONICOM sparsity and compare them with the completed MCAR v3.2, FSP-AE, and RANF experiment.

dataset.name: SONICOM FreeFieldCompMinPhase 44.1 kHz
dataset.evaluation_mask_policy: At every Q and for every method, exclude all 26 directions in SONICOM-Q26-v1 and evaluate the same remaining 767 targets.

baseline_methods.label: SH only
baseline_methods.definition: Complex SH interpolation without directional equalization; Nmax=3 and Tikhonov epsilon=1e-2.

baseline_methods.label: SUpDEq + SH
baseline_methods.definition: Directional equalization followed by SH interpolation; no MCA magnitude correction.

baseline_methods.label: SUpDEq + Natural Neighbor
baseline_methods.definition: Directional equalization with upstream SUpDEq natural-neighbor geometry.

baseline_methods.label: SUpDEq + Barycentric
baseline_methods.definition: Directional equalization with upstream SUpDEq barycentric geometry.

baseline_methods.label: MCA
baseline_methods.definition: Magnitude-corrected, time-aligned interpolation recomputed from the current-Q observations.

existing_learned_result.reuse_policy: Read and copy the completed listener-level rows exactly; do not rerun or replace the three learned methods.

primary_analysis.robustness: Within-subject Q6-minus-Q26 degradation and fitted error slope per halving of direction count.
primary_analysis.comparisons: All 28 method pairs for Q6 endpoint error and Q6-minus-Q26 degradation; separately publish the 15 learned-versus-baseline pairs.
primary_analysis.interpretation: Lower endpoint error and lower positive degradation are better; flat curves are not considered robust when absolute endpoint error is high.

selection_policy: No grid, subject, method definition, checkpoint, metric, evaluation mask, or analysis rule may be changed in response to the results.
